# Junkerz LLC

Public information about Junkerz. This file is a navigation aid, not a requirement for search inclusion.

- [Junkerz](https://junkerz.com): An online marketplace connecting vehicle sellers with independent buyers and pickup partners in Dallas–Fort Worth and surrounding North Texas. The assigned buyer purchases and pays at pickup. Junkerz coordinates and provides support; it has no public storefront or walk-in salvage yard.
- [Request an offer](https://junkerz.com/quote): Vehicle details and customer contact information are required. Existing approval rules apply.
- [Service areas](https://junkerz.com/service-areas): DFW and surrounding towns. Pickup eligibility, address access and scheduling require confirmation with the assigned partner.
- [Junkerz terms](https://junkerz.com/terms)
- [Junkerz privacy](https://junkerz.com/privacy-policy)

Only a ready offer without a human-approval requirement may be described as approved or guaranteed. That offer is guaranteed when the vehicle, condition, major parts and ownership details match the seller's description. Any difference must be explained before the seller agrees to a revised offer. Reviewing is pending approval; the customer may still accept and request scheduling through their private link while final confirmation remains pending. A missing title requires review of ownership and acceptable documents; possession or property ownership alone does not establish authority to sell a vehicle. Never fabricate quotes, coverage or pickup slots. Keep private quote links and customer information out of public search indexes.
